title: Transfer codes: what a connector's get or send may say it kept, changed and did not carry, per capability route (E184)
description: The ceiling of a transfer receipt (R-K3): a receipt row's code must be listed here for the receipt's capability route and in the row's own list, and its sentence is the template filled with the row's own measure. A changed code carries the difference the connector's independent check allows (exact; float32: one float32 unit; z-step: half of one of 65,534 steps of the inline's range of values plus one float32 unit, as OpendTect stores a horizon). A route without a row here has no receipt. The capability files are not changed by this document. Version 1.1.0 keeps the three horizon routes of 1.0.0 as they are and adds OpendTect's well log get (E184 slice 1); 1.0.0 is unchanged and its receipts are still kept.
